blocks.text: This Equipment Lease Agreement (as it may be amended from time to time, this "Agreement"), dated as of [DATE], is entered into by and between URBAN COWBOY RENTALS, LLC, a Utah limited liability company having its principal place of business at 1032 E 1700 S, Salt Lake City, Utah 84105 ("Lessor"), and [LESSEE NAME], a [STATE OF ORGANIZATION] UTAH, [ENTITY TYPE] having [its principal place of business/an address] at [LESSEE BUSINESS ADDRESS] ("Lessee," and together with Lessor, the "Parties," and each, a "Party").
WHEREAS, Lessor is in the business of leasing certain equipment, vehicles, and other assets of the Lessor; and
WHEREAS, Lessee desires to lease from Lessor, and Lessor desires to lease to Lessee the Units (as hereinafter defined).

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements hereinafter set forth and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

1. Equipment. Lessor hereby leases the Units described in Exhibit A attached hereto (the "Units," and each, a "Unit") to Lessee and Lessee hereby accepts the Units for all purposes of this Agreement and leases the Units from Lessor subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
2. Delivery Location. The delivery location under this Agreement is [LOCATION].

3. Delivery Date. The delivery date under this Agreement is [DATE]. Lessor shall use reasonable efforts to meet the delivery date, but Lessor shall have no responsibility or liability for delays in delivery.

4. True Lease. The Parties intend that this Agreement shall constitute a true lease under applicable law. Lessor has title to the Units at all times. Lessee acquires no ownership, title, property, right, equity, or interest in the Units other than its leasehold interest solely as lessee subject to all the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

5. Security Interest. The Parties intend and agree that, if this Agreement is recharacterized under applicable law as a secured financing or a lease intended for security, this Agreement shall be deemed a security agreement and Section 1 hereof shall be deemed to grant Lessor by Lessee a lien on and first priority security interest in the Units and all proceeds thereof, to secure the payment of Lessee's obligations under this Agreement. Lessor and Lessee each agree to execute, acknowledge, deliver, file, and record, or cause to be executed, acknowledged, delivered, filed, and recorded such further documents (including without limitation UCC financing statements), and to do all such things and acts, necessary to ensure that such security interest would be a perfected first priority security interest under applicable law.
6. Net Lease. This is a net lease.

7. No Setoff. Lessee's obligation to pay all rent and other amounts under this Agreement is absolute and unconditional and is not subject to any abatement, counterclaim, defense, deferment, interruption, recoupment, reduction, or setoff for any reason whatsoever.
8. Commencement Date. The "Commencement Date" of this Agreement is [DATE]
9. Expiration Date. The "Expiration Date" of this Agreement is [DATE]
10. RENT AND CHARGES

10.1 Rent.The term hereof with respect to any Unit shall commence on the Commencement Date and, unless sooner terminated hereunder, shall expire on the later of the Expiration Date or the date such Unit is returned to and accepted by Lessor in the condition required hereunder ("Term"). During the Term for any Unit, Lessee shall pay to Lessor the rental rates, fees, charges, deposits, and other amounts set forth in Exhibit C attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference. All rental amounts shall be payable in accordance with the provisions of Section 11 of this Agreement. Any additional rental charges, extensions, late fees, fuel charges, cleaning charges, damage charges, transportation charges, taxes, or other amounts due under this Agreement shall be deemed additional rent and shall be payable by Lessee upon demand by Lessor. Rental rates set forth in Exhibit C do not include applicable sales, use, excise, or similar taxes. Lessee shall be responsible for payment of all applicable federal, state, and local taxes associated with the rental of any Unit.

10.2 Security Deposit. Lessee shall provide a refundable security deposit in the amount set forth in Exhibit C. The security deposit shall secure Lessee's performance of all obligations under this Agreement. Lessor may apply all or any portion of the security deposit toward unpaid rent, damages, loss, cleaning charges, fuel charges, transportation charges, late fees, collection costs, or any other amounts due under this Agreement. The security deposit shall not limit Lessee's liability for amounts exceeding the deposit. Following the return of all equipment and satisfaction of all obligations under this Agreement, Lessee must submit a written request for the return of any remaining security deposit. Within a reasonable time after receipt of such written request and completion of Lessor's inspection of the equipment, Lessor shall return any remaining balance of the security deposit to Lessee, less any deductions permitted under this Agreement.
10.3 Additional Charges and Fees.

(a) Fuel Surcharge. Lessee shall return each Unit with the same fuel level as when delivered. If additional fuel is required, Lessee shall reimburse Lessor at two (2) times the actual fuel cost incurred by Lessor. Fuel surcharge rates and calculations are further described in Schedule 2.

(b) Delivery and Pickup Fees. Delivery and pickup services are available at the request of Lessee and shall be billed in accordance with Schedule 2. Delivery and pickup charges may be assessed at rates up to Four Dollars ($4.00) per loaded mile, plus any applicable taxes, tolls, permits, or other transportation-related expenses incurred by Lessor.

(c) Cleaning Fees. Lessee shall return each Unit in substantially the same clean condition as when delivered. If cleaning is required, Lessor may assess interior and exterior cleaning charges at the rate of One Dollar ($1.00) per minute. Cleaning charges shall be billed in accordance with Schedule 2.

(d) Impound and Recovery Charges. If any Unit becomes subject to impound, seizure, storage, towing, recovery, or similar action during the rental period, Lessee shall be solely responsible for all impound fees, storage fees, administrative fees, release fees, towing fees, and any other charges associated with the recovery and release of the Unit. Impound fees shall be charged in accordance with applicable Utah law and shall be paid separately from rental charges.

(e) Recovery Services. If Lessor is required to recover, retrieve, transport, or otherwise secure a Unit due to impound, abandonment, improper use, accident, repossession, recovery, or any other circumstance attributable to Lessee, such recovery services shall be billed at Two Hundred Eighty Dollars ($280.00) per hour, portal-to-portal, with a one (1) hour minimum charge. Any portion of an hour shall be billed as a full hour. In addition, Lessee shall be responsible for any equipment charges, subcontractor charges, permits, towing charges, storage charges, mileage charges, administrative costs, and other expenses incurred by Lessor.

(f) Additional Rent. All fees, surcharges, charges, expenses, and amounts described in this Section 10.3 and Schedule 2 shall constitute additional rent under this Agreement and shall be immediately due and payable upon demand by Lessor.

11. PAYMENT MECHANICS.Lessee shall pay all rental charges, deposits, damage charges, taxes, fees, and other amounts due under this Agreement in full at the commencement of the rental period unless otherwise agreed in writing by Lessor. Security deposits shall be paid before any equipment is released to Lessee. Payment may be made by cash, credit card, debit card, or any other payment method approved by Lessor. As a condition of rental, Lessee shall complete and execute the Credit Card Authorization Form attached hereto as Schedule 1. Lessee authorizes Lessor to charge any unpaid rental fees, extensions, damages, cleaning charges, fuel charges, transportation charges, taxes, late fees, stipulated loss values, collection costs, attorney fees, and any other amounts due under this Agreement to the payment method identified in Schedule 1. Returned payments, chargebacks, revoked authorizations, or declined transactions shall constitute a default under this Agreement, and all associated collection costs, attorney fees, court costs, bank charges, and costs of collection shall be the responsibility of Lessee. Rental Invoices. Lessor may issue one or more Rental Invoices, Rental Orders, Equipment Checkout Forms, Reservations, Confirmations, or similar transaction documents in connection with any rental. Each such document shall be incorporated into and governed by this Agreement. In the event of any conflict between a Rental Invoice and this Agreement, the terms of this Agreement shall control unless expressly modified in writing and signed by both Parties.

12. Late Payments. If Lessee does not pay any amount payable to Lessor under this Agreement within two (2) days after the due date, Lessee shall pay to Lessor a late charge equal to the lower of (a) the maximum amount allowed by law and (b) 1.5% of the late payment amount for each day payment is overdue. Payment of any late charge does not excuse Lessee from any default under this Agreement.
13. EXCLUSION OF WARRANTIES. LESSOR MAKES NO WARRANTY WHATSOEVER, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY (a) WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY; (b) WARRANTY OF FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE;

(c) WARRANTY AGAINST INTERFERENCE; OR (d) WARRANTY AGAINST INFRINGEMENT OF ANY PATENT, COPYRIGHT, TRADEMARK, TRADE SECRET, OR OTHER PROPRIETARY RIGHTS OF A THIRD PARTY; WHETHER ARISING BY LAW, COURSE OF DEALING, COURSE OF PERFORMANCE, USAGE OF TRADE, OR OTHERWISE.
14. Lessee's Representations. Lessee represents and warrants for the benefit of Lessor that the statements in this Section 14 are true and correct as of the date hereof.
14.1 ENTITY TYPE] duly organized, validly existing, in good standing, and duly licensed and qualified to do business under applicable law.Lessee is a [

14.2 Lessee has full corporate power and authority to enter into this Agreement, carry out its obligations hereunder, and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. This Agreement has been duly executed and delivered by Lessee, and constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Lessee enforceable against Lessee in accordance with its terms.

14.3 The execution, delivery, and performance by Lessee of this Agreement will not require the consent of any party, result in any lien on any Unit, or conflict with the organizational documents of Lessee, any provision of applicable law, or any instrument by which Lessee is bound.
14.4 There are no actions pending or threatened against or by Lessee challenging the transactions contemplated by this Agreement and no circumstances exist that may give rise to such an action.

14.5 On or prior to the date of this Agreement, Lessee has provided Lessor with insurance certificates accurately evidencing that the insurance coverage required under Section 19 hereof is in effect and with insurance certificates accurately evidencing that the insurance coverage required as of the date of this Agreement under Section 19 hereof is in effect.

14.6 If not publicly available, Lessee has delivered complete copies of Lessee's financial statements for its most recent fiscal year and any other financial information of Lessee reasonably requested by Lessor, fairly presenting the financial condition and operations of Lessee's business as of the dates such statements and information were prepared.

15. Lessee's Covenants. Lessee agrees that until all amounts payable under this Agreement have been paid in full and all other obligations hereunder have been performed in full, Lessee shall comply with the covenants in this Section 15.
15.1 Lessee shall comply with all applicable law.
15.2 Lessee shall maintain in full force and effect all permits required to continue conducting its business and to lease and use each Unit in the manner contemplated under this Agreement.

15.3 Lessee shall pay, and indemnify and hold Lessor harmless from, all assessments, license fees, and sales, use, property, excise, and other taxes and charges (other than gross or net income taxes) arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, the consummation of the transactions contemplated herein, or the shipment, possession, ownership, use, delivery, or operation of any Unit.
15.4 Lessee shall keep the Units free and clear of all liens.

15.5 enter into any sublease of any Unit without Lessor's prior written consent, which consent may be withheld in Lessor's sole discretion. No permitted sublease shall relieve Lessee of its obligations under this Agreement.Lessee shall not
16. Lessee's Use of Equipment.

16.1 No marking of any kind shall be placed on any Unit by Lessee except with the prior written consent of Lessor. Any such marking placed on a Unit by Lessee shall be removed at Lessee's expense on or before the expiration or earlier termination of the Term for such Unit. Lessee shall, at Lessee's expense and to Lessor's satisfaction, place and maintain on each Unit any identifying marks required by Lessor.

16.2 remain at all times personal property and not a fixture under applicable law, even if the Unit, or any part thereof, may be or become affixed or attached to real property or any improvements.The Parties intend that each Unit shall
16.3 Lessee shall operate each Unit exclusively in connection with its business. Lessee shall not operate or permit the operation of any Unit in an unsafe or improper manner.

16.4 Lessee, at its own expense, shall maintain all records, logs, and other materials related to the Units ("Records") using practices and with a degree of care, comprehensiveness, and accuracy consistent with industry practice, but in no event less than reasonable practices and a reasonable degree of care, comprehensiveness, and accuracy, and as required by applicable law, and promptly furnish to Lessor such Records as may be requested by Lessor for any purpose.

16.5 right of access to Lessee's premises to inspect the Units and Lessee's Records on reasonable notice and during regular business hours. On Lessor's request, Lessee shall cooperate with and assist Lessor in obtaining access to premises other than Lessee's so that Lessor's employees and agents may inspect the Units.Lessor's employees and agents shall have the

16.6 INSPECTION, CONDITION, AND ACCEPTANCE. Each serialized Unit and the applicable current equipment-specific Check-Out / Check-In Inspection Form shall be identified in, referenced by, or otherwise associated with the applicable Rental Schedule, invoice, Transaction Schedule, or other rental documentation. Such operational inspection forms may record the invoice number, customer or Lessee, check-out and check-in dates and times, hour meter readings, hours used, fuel level, inspecting employee or representative, equipment-specific condition ratings, photographs, existing or newly identified damage, missing equipment, accessories or attachments, additional return charges, damage determinations, customer acknowledgments, and representative certifications. Before operating or using a Unit, Lessee shall inspect the Unit or review the documented check-out condition and shall promptly notify Lessor of any visible damage, missing component or attachment, unsafe condition, or material discrepancy. Lessee's acceptance, signature, or acknowledgment of a condition record constitutes evidence of the condition reasonably observable at the time stated but does not waive a claim concerning a latent or hidden defect that could not reasonably have been discovered through ordinary inspection, nor does it waive any duty or remedy that cannot lawfully be waived. Lessor may use equipment- specific Check-Out / Check-In Inspection Forms for different Units, and those forms are incorporated as operational records when identified with the applicable rental transaction. Such forms supplement, but do not replace or amend, this Agreement unless an amendment is expressly agreed to in writing. In the event of a conflict, this Agreement controls unless a later written amendment expressly states otherwise. Lessee's general condition and return acknowledgment is set forth in Exhibit D.
17. Maintenance and Mandatory Modifications.

17.1 Lessee, at its sole expense and consistent with standard industry practice for similar equipment, Lessee's maintenance practices for its other similar equipment, and applicable insurance requirements, shall maintain, service, and repair each Unit and keep each Unit in compliance with any vendor's or manufacturer's specifications and applicable law, in serviceable and operable condition, free of broken, damaged, or missing parts, suitable for the commercial use originally intended[, ordinary wear and tear excepted]. All maintenance, service, and repair of any Unit and any part thereof shall be done to standards and with parts of like kind and at least equal quality to items being maintained, serviced, or repaired.

17.2 If during the Term hereof any part of any Unit is lost, stolen, damaged beyond repair, or otherwise permanently rendered unfit for use, Lessee, at its sole expense, shall promptly replace or cause to be replaced such part with one or more replacement parts. Lessee shall cause such Unit after the replacement to be in as good an operating condition as, and have a value, remaining useful life, and utility at least equal to the value, remaining useful life, and utility of the Unit before the replacement (assuming such Unit to have been in the condition required by the terms of this Agreement).

17.3 Lessee, at its sole expense, shall make any alteration or modification to any Unit, including without limitation the replacement or addition of any component, that is required or supplied by the Lessor or the manufacturer or necessary to comply with applicable law. Lessee shall notify Lessor within ten (10) days of learning that an alteration or modification is required by applicable law.

17.4 parts to be free and clear of any lien.If Lessee incorporates or installs any part in or attaches any part to a Unit, including without limitation any replacement or addition under Section 17.3, then immediately on any part becoming incorporated or installed in or attached to the Unit, without further act or any cost to Lessor, such part is deemed part of the Unit to the same extent as though originally incorporated or installed in or attached to the Unit, title to such part vests in Lessor, and such part becomes subject to this Agreement. Lessee shall cause all

17.5 BREAKDOWN, SERVICE, MALFUNCTION, AND COMPANY RESPONSE. Lessee shall immediately discontinue use of any Unit upon the occurrence or discovery of any warning indicator, defect, breakdown, material malfunction, abnormal operation, damage, or condition that is or reasonably appears to be unsafe or that could cause further damage to the Unit, other property, or any person. Lessee shall promptly notify Lessor at 801-903-9380 and shall not resume operation unless and until authorized by Lessor. Lessor shall determine, in its reasonable discretion, whether to inspect, diagnose, repair, replace, recover, or authorize limited emergency measures concerning the affected Unit. Lessee shall not perform or authorize repairs, alterations, towing, recovery, disassembly, or replacement of parts without Lessor's prior authorization, except for reasonable measures necessary to prevent imminent bodily injury or material additional property damage. Lessee shall follow all stop-use instructions issued by Lessor. Any rental credit, replacement equipment, refund, downtime treatment, or other remedy arising from a breakdown or service interruption shall be determined under this Agreement and any applicable written Rental Schedule or service policy issued by Lessor. Lessor shall not be responsible for delay or inability to perform caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control; provided, however, that nothing in this Agreement waives any duty or remedy that cannot lawfully be waived.
18. Loss.

18.1 From the Commencement Date through the expiration or earlier termination of the Term hereunder as to any Unit, Lessee shall bear all risk of loss, damage, destruction, theft, taking, confiscation, or requisition, partial or complete, of or to such Unit or its use, however caused or occasioned ("Loss"). Lessee shall notify Lessor in writing within five (5) days of learning of any such Loss.
18.2 The "Stipulated Loss Values" for the Units are as set forth in the attached Exhibit B.

18.3 If Lessor determines in its sole discretion that a Loss has materially impaired the Unit affected or its use, Lessee shall pay, on Lessor's demand ("Loss Payment Date"), all rent and other amounts due prior to the Loss Payment Date with respect to such Unit plus the Stipulated Loss Value of the Unit determined in accordance with Exhibit B hereto (collectively, "Loss Payment"). This Agreement shall terminate with respect to any materially impaired Unit on receipt by Lessor of the corresponding Loss Payment. Upon such receipt and termination, Lessor shall deliver to Lessee a duly executed quitclaim bill of sale conveying title to such Unit to Lessee.

18.4 If Lessor determines in its sole discretion that a Loss has not materially impaired the Unit affected or its use, this Agreement shall continue with respect to such Unit as though no Loss had occurred; and Lessee shall at its sole expense promptly repair or cause to be repaired such Unit to the condition in which such Unit is required to be maintained hereunder, to the satisfaction of Lessor. For the avoidance of doubt, there shall be no abatement of rent or rent credit for any period in which a Unit is in a shop or otherwise out of operation in connection with any maintenance, repairs, or mandatory modifications under this Section 18 or Section 17 hereof.

18.5 ACCIDENTS, DAMAGE, THEFT, CITATIONS, IMPOUND, AND CLAIMS. Upon any accident, collision, injury, property damage, fire, theft, attempted theft, vandalism, impound, citation, claim, material malfunction, or other event involving or affecting a Unit, Lessee shall immediately take reasonable steps to protect persons and property, contact emergency services or law enforcement when appropriate, discontinue use when continued operation could be unsafe or cause additional damage, secure the Unit and surrounding property, and notify Lessor at 801-903-9380. Theft, serious bodily injury, fire, impound, or significant property damage shall be reported to Lessor by telephone immediately or as soon as reasonably practicable under the circumstances. All other events covered by this Section shall be reported promptly and, in all events, no later than twenty-four (24) hours after the event or Lessee's discovery of it. Lessee shall obtain and preserve, to the extent reasonably available, the names and contact information of involved persons and witnesses, insurance information, law-enforcement or agency report numbers, photographs or video, citation or impound documentation, and other relevant non-privileged evidence. Lessee shall not admit liability, assume obligations, settle a claim, or make representations on behalf of Lessor. Lessee shall reasonably cooperate with Lessor, its insurers, law enforcement, recovery personnel, and claims professionals in the investigation, preservation, recovery, adjustment, defense, or resolution of any incident or claim. Lessee shall not repair, dispose of, transfer, conceal, abandon, or materially alter a Unit or evidence relating to an incident without Lessor's prior direction or authorization, except for reasonable measures necessary to prevent imminent bodily injury or material additional property damage.
19. INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS AND OPTIONAL RENTAL DAMAGE WAIVER.

For purposes of this Section 19, “Lessor” means Urban Cowboy Rentals, LLC, and “Lessee” means the individual or legal entity identified as the renter under this Agreement. “Equipment” means each Unit and any equipment, machinery, attachment, accessory, trailer, component, and related property identified in the applicable Rental Schedule, Equipment Schedule, invoice, or other rental documentation incorporated into this Agreement.

Lessee’s obligations under this Section shall commence upon the earlier of delivery of the Equipment to Lessee or Lessee’s taking possession, custody, or control of the Equipment and shall continue until the Equipment has been physically returned to and accepted by Lessor.
19.1 CLASSIFICATION OF LESSEE.
For purposes of determining the applicable insurance requirements, Lessee shall be classified as either:

(a) Commercial/Business Lessee. Any corporation, limited liability company, partnership, sole proprietorship, contractor, subcontractor, governmental entity, association, or individual renting or using Equipment primarily in connection with a trade, business, profession, occupation, construction activity, income-producing activity, or other commercial purpose; or
(b) Personal/Homeowner Lessee. An individual renting and using Equipment primarily for personal, household, residential, or other non- commercial purposes.
Lessor may reasonably determine the applicable classification based upon the identity of Lessee and the disclosed intended use of the Equipment.
19.2 COMMERCIAL/BUSINESS LESSEE – LIABILITY INSURANCE.

Every Commercial/Business Lessee shall, at its sole cost and expense, procure and maintain throughout the Rental Term Commercial General Liability (“CGL”) Insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence for bodily injury, personal injury, and property damage arising out of or relating to Lessee’s operations, possession, transportation, maintenance, or use of the Equipment.
To the extent available under the applicable policy and endorsements, such insurance shall:
(a) name Urban Cowboy Rentals, LLC as an Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of Lessee’s possession, transportation, operation, or use of the Equipment;
(b) apply on a primary and non-contributory basis with respect to insurance maintained by Lessor;
(c) include a waiver of subrogation in favor of Lessor to the extent commercially available and permitted by law; and
(d) provide such notice of cancellation or material reduction in coverage as is available under the applicable policy or endorsement.
The insurance requirements contained in this Section establish minimum contractual requirements only and shall not be construed as limiting Lessee’s liability or obligations under this Agreement.
19.3 COMMERCIAL/BUSINESS LESSEE – PHYSICAL DAMAGE COVERAGE.

Unless Lessee elects and Lessor accepts the Rental Damage Waiver described in Section 19.7, Commercial/Business Lessee shall maintain insurance covering physical loss of or damage to the Equipment, including theft, vandalism, fire, collision, overturn, and other direct physical loss, in an amount not less than the greater of the Stipulated Loss Value or full replacement value of the Equipment. Where available and applicable, Urban Cowboy Rentals, LLC shall be named as Loss Payee with respect to the Equipment. Lessee shall be solely responsible for all deductibles, self-insured retentions, exclusions, coverage limitations, denied claims, and uninsured losses.
19.4 PERSONAL/HOMEOWNER LESSEE.

A Personal/Homeowner Lessee shall remain financially responsible for loss of or damage to the Equipment during the Rental Term except to the extent that (a) such loss or damage is actually paid by applicable insurance; or (b) Lessee has affirmatively elected and paid for Lessor’s Rental Damage Waiver and the particular loss is subject to the waiver pursuant to Section 19.7. Lessor does not represent or warrant that any homeowners, renters, automobile, personal liability, umbrella, credit-card, or other insurance maintained by Lessee provides coverage for rented Equipment or liability arising from its transportation or operation. Lessee is solely responsible for determining the existence and extent of any applicable personal insurance coverage.
19.5 WORKERS’ COMPENSATION AND EMPLOYER’S LIABILITY.

Any Commercial/Business Lessee required by applicable law to maintain workers’ compensation insurance shall maintain such coverage in accordance with all applicable statutory requirements. Where applicable, Lessee shall also maintain Employer’s Liability Insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per accident for bodily injury by accident, together with such other limits as may be required by applicable law.
19.6 AUTOMOBILE AND TOWING LIABILITY.

If Lessee transports or tows Equipment using Lessee’s vehicle, trailer, employee, agent, contractor, or other means of transportation, Lessee shall be solely responsible for maintaining all automobile liability insurance required by applicable law. Lessee shall be solely responsible for verifying that the tow vehicle, trailer, hitch, coupler, safety chains, braking system, tires, load securement, Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (“GVWR”), Gross Combined Weight Rating (“GCWR”), and operator qualifications are lawful and adequate for the Equipment being transported. Acceptance or inspection of any tow vehicle or transportation arrangement by Lessor shall not constitute certification by Lessor that such vehicle or arrangement is safe, lawful, or adequate.
19.7 OPTIONAL RENTAL DAMAGE WAIVER (“RDW”).

Subject to Lessor’s approval and the terms of this Agreement, both Commercial/Business Lessees and Personal/Homeowner Lessees may elect to purchase an optional Rental Damage Waiver (“RDW”) for an additional charge.
THE RENTAL DAMAGE WAIVER IS NOT LIABILITY INSURANCE AND IS NOT INTENDED TO CONSTITUTE AN INSURANCE POLICY.

The RDW constitutes a contractual agreement by Lessor to waive or limit a portion of Lessee’s otherwise applicable financial responsibility to Lessor for certain qualifying accidental direct physical loss of or damage to covered Equipment occurring during the Rental Term. The RDW applies only to Equipment specifically identified in the applicable Rental Agreement, Rental Schedule, invoice, or other written documentation as being subject to the RDW and only after payment of the applicable RDW charge. The RDW is optional and shall become effective only upon Lessee’s affirmative written or electronic election and Lessor’s acceptance.

19.8 RDW DEDUCTIBLE. Each covered loss shall be subject to the applicable Damage Waiver Deductible stated in Exhibit B for the affected Unit, or such other deductible or retained responsibility amount expressly stated in the applicable Rental Schedule, invoice, or RDW election. Lessee shall remain responsible for payment of the applicable Damage Waiver Deductible notwithstanding Lessee's purchase of the RDW. Unless expressly stated otherwise in writing, a separate deductible shall apply to each occurrence and each item of Equipment damaged or lost. Lessee's eligibility for any waiver or limitation of responsibility under the RDW is also subject to Lessee's compliance with the incident reporting, evidence-preservation, cooperation, stop-use, and Company-direction requirements of Sections 17.5 and 18.5, but a failure to comply shall affect RDW protection only to the extent expressly provided by the applicable RDW terms, conditions, or exclusions and permitted by law.

Each covered loss shall be subject to the deductible or retained responsibility amount specified for the applicable Equipment in Exhibit B, as may be supplemented by the applicable Rental Schedule, invoice, or RDW election. Lessee shall remain responsible for payment of the applicable deductible notwithstanding Lessee’s purchase of the RDW. Unless expressly stated otherwise in writing, a separate deductible shall apply to each occurrence and each item of Equipment damaged or lost.
19.9 RDW DOES NOT PROVIDE GENERAL LIABILITY COVERAGE.

THE RENTAL DAMAGE WAIVER DOES NOT PROVIDE COMMERCIAL GENERAL LIABILITY, PERSONAL LIABILITY, AUTOMOBILE LIABILITY, PROPERTY DAMAGE LIABILITY, BODILY INJURY LIABILITY, WORKERS’ COMPENSATION, EMPLOYER’S LIABILITY, OR ANY OTHER THIRD-PARTY LIABILITY COVERAGE.
Without limiting the foregoing, the RDW does not waive, assume, insure, defend, indemnify, or pay Lessee’s liability arising from:
(a) bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death of any person;
(b) damage to real or personal property belonging to any person or entity other than Lessor;
(c) damage to buildings, structures, vehicles, utilities, landscaping, pavement, roadways, underground facilities, or other third-party property;
(d) automobile, trailer, transportation, or towing liability;
(e) environmental contamination or remediation;
(f ) workers’ compensation or employer liability; or
(g) fines, penalties, citations, assessments, or governmental charges.
Lessee remains responsible for such liability to the extent imposed upon Lessee by applicable law or this Agreement.
PURCHASE OF THE RDW DOES NOT SATISFY THE COMMERCIAL GENERAL LIABILITY INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS APPLICABLE TO A COMMERCIAL/BUSINESS LESSEE UNDER SECTION 19.2.
19.10 EXCLUSIONS FROM RENTAL DAMAGE WAIVER.
Notwithstanding Lessee’s purchase of the RDW, Lessor shall have no obligation to waive Lessee’s financial responsibility for loss or damage arising directly or indirectly from:
(a) intentional acts, intentional damage, abuse, misuse, gross negligence, reckless conduct, or willful misconduct;
(b) operation by any person who is unauthorized, unqualified, underage, impaired, intoxicated, or otherwise prohibited from operating the Equipment;
(c) use of the Equipment for an unlawful purpose or in violation of this Agreement;
(d) operation contrary to manufacturer instructions, safety warnings, rated capacities, or operating limitations;
(e) overloading, overworking, or using the Equipment for a purpose for which it was not designed;
(f ) improper loading, unloading, towing, transportation, tie-down, or securement;
(g) use of incorrect fuel, DEF, hydraulic fluid, oil, lubricant, coolant, or other fluid;
(h) failure to maintain required fluid levels or ordinary operating maintenance required of Lessee;

(i) continued operation after a warning light, alarm, overheating condition, low-fluid condition, visible leak, unusual noise, loss of hydraulic pressure, mechanical malfunction, or other condition reasonably requiring shutdown;

(j) tire or track damage resulting from abuse, excessive spinning, cutting, puncture, improper operation, or operation on unsuitable surfaces, except to the extent resulting directly from an otherwise covered accidental occurrence;
(k) theft, attempted theft, or vandalism where Lessee failed to exercise reasonable care to secure the Equipment;
(l) leaving ignition keys, access devices, or security credentials in or with unattended Equipment;
(m) abandonment, conversion, concealment, unauthorized sale, unauthorized sublease, unauthorized transfer, or failure to return the Equipment;
(n) loss occurring outside any geographical area authorized by Lessor;
(o) loss occurring after expiration or termination of the authorized Rental Term while Lessee continues to possess the Equipment without Lessor’s written authorization;
(p) failure to comply with applicable excavation, utility-location, permitting, or safety requirements; or
(q) any additional exclusion conspicuously identified in the Rental Agreement, Rental Schedule, or RDW election applicable to the Equipment.
If an exclusion applies, Lessee shall remain liable for the full amount otherwise recoverable under this Agreement, without reduction attributable to the RDW.
19.11 LESSEE’S CONTINUING RESPONSIBILITY.

Except to the extent expressly waived by Lessor under an applicable RDW or actually satisfied by insurance proceeds received by Lessor, Lessee assumes responsibility for physical loss of or damage to the Equipment occurring while the Equipment is in Lessee’s possession, custody, or control, subject to applicable law and the other terms of this Agreement. Lessee’s obligations are not discharged because (a) Lessee maintained insurance; (b) Lessor accepted a certificate of insurance; (c) an insurer denies or limits coverage; (d) applicable insurance contains a deductible or self-insured retention; or (e) insurance proceeds are insufficient to satisfy Lessee’s obligations.
19.12 PROOF OF INSURANCE.

When insurance is required under this Agreement, Lessee shall, upon Lessor’s request and before delivery or release of the Equipment, furnish certificates of insurance and such endorsements or other evidence of coverage as Lessor may reasonably require. Lessor’s review, acceptance, or failure to request evidence of insurance shall not (a) waive any requirement of this Agreement; (b) constitute a representation that Lessee’s insurance is sufficient; (c) impose upon Lessor any obligation to verify coverage; or (d) reduce Lessee’s obligations under this Agreement. Lessor may refuse to release Equipment when Lessee fails to provide required evidence of insurance.
19.13 INSURANCE PROCEEDS.

To the extent permitted by applicable law and the applicable insurance policy, insurance proceeds attributable to physical loss of or damage to Lessor’s Equipment shall be payable to Urban Cowboy Rentals, LLC as owner and/or Loss Payee. DECLINATION OF RDW: If Lessee declines the Rental Damage Waiver, Lessee acknowledges that Lessee remains financially responsible for loss of or damage to the Equipment in accordance with this Agreement, subject to applicable law and any insurance available to satisfy such obligation.

Unless Lessor expressly agrees otherwise in writing, any approved extension or renewal shall be charged at Lessor's then-current applicable rental rate and shall remain subject to all terms, conditions, duties, risk-of-loss provisions, Damage Waiver Deductibles, and other obligations of this Agreement. Lessee's continued possession or use of Equipment beyond the authorized Rental Term does not constitute an approved renewal or extension and may result in additional rent, late-return charges, recovery costs, and other remedies permitted by this Agreement or applicable law.

A Lessee may request an option to purchase rented Equipment, but no purchase option exists unless Lessor expressly grants the option in a written Rental Schedule, purchase-option addendum, invoice, or other written or electronic document identifying the applicable Unit and the purchase terms. Any approved purchase option shall state the purchase price or the method for determining the purchase price, the option expiration date, the amount, if any, of rental payments or other charges to be credited toward the purchase price, applicable taxes and fees, and any other conditions required by Lessor. Unless expressly stated otherwise in the written purchase option, rental payments, Rental Damage Waiver charges, delivery or pickup charges, deposits, late charges, repair charges, Damage Waiver Deductibles, taxes, and other fees shall not be credited toward the purchase price. Exercise of a purchase option shall not transfer title until Lessor has received all amounts due under the purchase option and this Agreement in collected funds and has delivered written evidence of transfer. Until title transfers, the Equipment remains the sole property of Lessor and all provisions of this Agreement remain in effect. Equipment purchased pursuant to an option shall be sold in its then-existing condition, subject to any non-waivable rights under applicable law and any express written warranty, if any, provided by Lessor at the time of sale.
